title: Zcash price reclaims $800 as coinholders vote on major NU7 changes
summary: ZEC recovered to around $826 while Zcash coinholders considered five questions that could shape the network’s upcoming NU7 upgrade.
content: The privacy-focused cryptocurrency Zcash recently saw its price recover to around $826, reclaiming the $800 level. This market movement coincided with coinholders participating in a vote on five key questions designed to shape the network's upcoming major NU7 upgrade.

title: Universities Are Cloning Their Professors With AI
summary:
At first glance, Harvard Business School senior lecturer Jeff Bussgang looks ordinary on a video call, smiling, ready to hear a founder’s pitch. He isn’t there. The student is talking to an artificial intelligence avatar built from Bussgang’s likeness, one of seven Harvard faculty who volunteered to be cloned, Entrepreneur reported. The avatars power HBS […]
The post Universities Are Cloning Their Professors With AI  appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Universities are increasingly utilizing artificial intelligence by creating digital avatars of professors. At Harvard Business School, select faculty members have volunteered to be cloned into AI avatars for video interactions. These digital replicas help power educational programs and student interactions, showcasing a growing trend of generative technology adoption in higher education.

title: Investors react negatively to Federal Reserve chairman’s press conference
summary:
Investor uncertainty due to unclear Fed guidance may lead to increased market volatility and potential shifts in economic policy expectations.
The post Investors react negatively to Federal Reserve chairman’s press conference appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Investors reacted negatively following the Federal Reserve chairman's recent press conference. Unclear guidance from the central bank has generated uncertainty across financial markets. This ambiguity could lead to increased market volatility and potential shifts in broader economic policy expectations moving forward as market participants assess the future outlook.

title: US judge rules Pentagon’s blacklist of Anthropic unlawful, calls it First Amendment retaliation
summary:
This ruling underscores the tension between national security and corporate autonomy, potentially reshaping AI governance and defense contracting norms.
The post US judge rules Pentagon’s blacklist of Anthropic unlawful, calls it First Amendment retaliation appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A United States judge has ruled that the Pentagon's decision to place artificial intelligence company Anthropic on a blacklist was unlawful. The court determined the action constituted First Amendment retaliation. This legal decision highlights ongoing tensions between national security policies and corporate autonomy, which could influence future governance and defense contracting standards.

title: BitGo buys NYDIG’s institutional trading business, expanding derivatives offering
summary: With the transaction, around 30 NYDIG employees have joined BitGo, along with their institutional trading relationships.
content: Digital asset custodian BitGo has acquired the institutional trading business of NYDIG. The transaction enables BitGo to expand its derivatives offerings. Approximately thirty employees from NYDIG have transitioned to BitGo alongside their established institutional trading relationships, bolstering BitGo's operational capabilities in the digital asset sector.

title: HashKey Cloud backs Stacks’ Genesis Bond to prove institutional appetite for native Bitcoin yield
summary:
The Genesis Bond avoids BTC lending and custody transfers while adding a 5% STX lock, managed parameters and variable payouts.
The post HashKey Cloud backs Stacks’ Genesis Bond to prove institutional appetite for native Bitcoin yield appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: HashKey Cloud is supporting Stacks’ Genesis Bond to demonstrate growing institutional demand for native Bitcoin yield. The financial product aims to avoid Bitcoin lending and custody transfers by incorporating a 5 percent STX lock, along with managed parameters and variable payouts for participants.
